plan.diagnosis: Maria is at high churn risk due to repeated airport short-fare losses after waits exceeding 90 minutes, with recent frustration specifically focused on airport queue issues.

actions.name: Standard Airport Short Fare Recovery
actions.rationale: Recommend a £25.00 standard airport short-fare recovery credit. The evidenced 135-minute wait and 1.5-kilometre trip meet the airport short-fare criteria, and £25.00 is the maximum permitted per instance for a Gold-tier driver. The complete ledger shows no month-to-date retention value and no immediate credits in the previous 24 hours, so the proposed credit remains within the monthly and credit-stacking guardrails. This is a recommendation only and does not indicate that payment has been issued or approved.

critic.summary: Plan satisfies all deterministic policy checks.
